title: Generosity notices an old condition’s pull

captions.physics: Sharing open support without a guarantee
captions.energy: Abandoning an unsound pattern of involvement
captions.emotions: Feeling binding expectation of reciprocal attention

meaning: Your open support can stay free when rejecting a mistaken pattern of care includes acknowledging the pull that still draws you towards its earlier condition.
text: Rejecting a mistaken rule does not always mean immediately ceasing to want the earlier response. In the physical position of Anahata, the Star shows open involvement: sharing support without a guaranteed outcome. The Tower in energy brings a wish to abandon an unsound caring pattern rather than preserve its convenient appearance. The Devil in emotions offers the pull of reciprocal attention that may bind again through expected debt. Helping freely may matter while releasing the pleasant power of being needed feels difficult. Tenderness allows this contradiction without making strong feeling an excuse for the former condition.

For example, one offers equipment for the other’s small creative project. Conversation acknowledges that earlier help required obligatory mention in every account of the work. **An open gesture does not require indefinite confirmation of the helper’s place.** This rule can be dropped even while wanting recognition remains strong. Revision concerns an actual condition rather than attractive words about freedom or a promise that resentment will never return.

Difficulty appears if a new offer becomes a test of whether a name will still be mentioned unasked. Alternatively, disappointment withdraws help. Care distinguishes wanting recognition from a right to demand continual attention. Specific gratitude can be requested and an actual contribution considered without making accepted support control every later account the other gives of their own activity.
